Proposition
[gradient, Hessian, and Laplacian of a Killing-field norm]

Source: petersen:page-0332 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-skew-symmetric ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-curvature-identities 1. ch8:8.2.1Let $X$ be a Killing field on $(M,g)$ and $f= frac 12g(X,X)= frac 12|X|^2$. Then

  1. $ abla f=- abla _XX$.

  2. $\mathrm{Hess}\, f(V,V)=| abla _VX|^2-R(V,X,X,V)$.

  3. $\Delta f=| abla X|^2-\mathrm{Ric}(X,X)$.

Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-norm-formulas \sketch For $f= frac 12|X|^2$, skew-adjointness from section 1 gives $D_Vf=g( abla _VX,X)=-g(V, abla _XX)$, proving the gradient identity. Differentiate once more and use $ abla ^2_{V,W}X=-R(X,V)W$ to obtain

\[ \operatorname {Hess}f(V,V)=| abla _VX|^2-R(V,X,X,V). \]

Tracing over an orthonormal frame yields $\Delta f=| abla X|^2-\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)$.

□
